page.notes: Fractions are set as stacked numerals and are transcribed in slash form. Left-margin notes of the facing page fragment are cut off in this part and are not transcribed. The lower lines of the displayed calculation continue beyond this part of the scan. The top line of fractions is cut off at the upper edge of this part. The fraction values are read from the scan and may be inexact. The left strip holds fragments of the other printed page: "erit:" at the top, and "er 20 dii" with "reos," beside the gutter, which are treated as margin notes of that page. The first line of the main text is therefore a fragment that continues from the upper part of the page.
